name: B10-0558/2025 – § 5 – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text: 5. Recalls that the Member States have sovereign choice regarding sexual and reproductive healthcare; recalls that freedom of opinion and expression for every citizen and every political organisation is a fundamental right of the European Union;
